content: Under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, any app providing algorithm-based portfolio/asset recommendations for compensation directed at specific individuals can be deemed 'investment advice,' requiring SEC/state RIA registration and fiduciary duty. Generic educational disclaimers alone do not guarantee exemption if the app functions like personalized advice; the safer legal posture is clearly educational/informational framing, no personalized buy/sell directives, and prominent 'not financial advice' disclaimers on every prediction/recommendation view.
